text: On the island of Baltrum, the painter Johan Borg barely sleeps, and his pregnant wife Alma sits up with him as he sketches the visions that torment him: [the Birdman, the Meat-Eaters, the Lady With a Hat|images|monsters and hybrid creatures]. In [the diary he hides under the bed|images|books, letters and writing] she reads of his former lover Veronica Vogler and of the baron in the nearby castle. Through the hour of the wolf, when most births and deaths occur, Johan confesses [a childhood spent locked in a closet|origin|harm done in childhood], and Alma fears [losing him to his demons|threat|the enemy within].
